name: Electron packaged CI

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, labeled, unlabeled, edited]
    # No GitHub paths filter: its 3,000-file cap can silently skip Host/provider changes.
    # The checked-out exact local git diff is classified by packaged-ci-cli.mts.

permissions:
  contents: read

# Metadata edits use unique groups and noncanonical check names, even if setup fails.
# A title/body edit must never cancel or replace checks for the same code.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}-${{ github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body) && format('metadata-{0}', github.run_id) || 'checks' }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && !(github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body)) }}

jobs:
  packaged-scope:
    name: classify packaged smoke
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      scope: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.scope }}
      run: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
      - name: Verify packaged CI policy contracts
        run: node --test scripts/ci/packaged-ci-policy.test.mts
      - name: Test provider archive integrity gate
        run: node --test scripts/ci/packaged-ci-provider-integrity.test.ts
      - name: Classify exact local PR diff
        id: scope
        run: node scripts/ci/packaged-ci-cli.mts classify

  packaged-smoke:
    needs: packaged-scope
    if: needs.packaged-scope.outputs.run == 'true' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    name: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body) && 'metadata packaged smoke' || 'packaged smoke' }} (${{ matrix.platform }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: darwin-arm64
            arch: arm64
            os: darwin
            runner: ${{ vars.CI_MACOS_ARM_RUNNER || 'namespace-profile-macos-15' }}
            pack: pack:mac:arm64
            bundle: release/mac-arm64/Agent Teams AI.app
          - platform: darwin-x64
            arch: x64
            os: darwin
            runner: macos-15-intel
            pack: pack:mac:x64
            bundle: release/mac/Agent Teams AI.app
          - platform: win32-x64
            arch: x64
            os: win32
            runner: windows-2022
            pack: pack:win:x64
            bundle: release/win-unpacked
          - platform: win32-arm64
            arch: arm64
            os: win32
            runner: windows-11-arm
            pack: pack:win:arm64
            bundle: release/win-arm64-unpacked
          - platform: linux-x64
            arch: x64
            os: linux
            runner: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
            pack: pack:linux
            bundle: release/linux-unpacked

    env:
      OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      OPENCODE_V2_TEST_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        if: matrix.os != 'darwin'
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install Linux packaging tools
        if: matrix.os == 'linux'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libarchive-tools rpm xvfb
      - name: Restore node-gyp executable bit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          for root in "$(pnpm store path)" "${PNPM_HOME:-}" "$(dirname "$(command -v pnpm)")"; do
            if [ -d "$root" ]; then
              find "$root" -path '*/node-gyp/gyp/gyp_main.py' -exec chmod +x {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
          done
      - name: Verify selected provider archives against frozen lock before install
        run: node scripts/ci/packaged-ci-provider-integrity.ts
      - name: Install frozen dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Verify managed Git pins and archive path safety
        run: node --test scripts/stage-managed-git.test.mjs
      - name: Validate packaged OpenCode project-path smoke syntax early
        if: matrix.os == 'darwin'
        run: node --check scripts/e2e/opencode-project-path-packaged.mjs
      - name: Typecheck packaged CI policy with pinned compiler
        run: node ./node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig/tsconfig.packaged-ci.json
      - name: Assert Electron binary was provisioned during install
        run: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const root=path.dirname(require.resolve('electron/package.json')); const marker=path.join(root,'path.txt'); if(!fs.existsSync(marker) || !fs.existsSync(path.join(root,'dist',fs.readFileSync(marker,'utf8')))) process.exit(1)"
      - name: Test bundled undici security version policy
        run: node --test test/scripts/verify-bundled-undici.test.cjs
      - name: Verify CI Node and Electron built-in undici versions
        run: node scripts/ci/verify-bundled-undici.cjs
      - name: Verify native rebuild
        run: pnpm exec electron-rebuild -f -o node-pty,ssh2,cpu-features,better-sqlite3
      - name: Stage bundled runtime
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
        run: node ./scripts/stage-runtime.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.platform }}
      - name: Stage terminal platform runtime
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: node ./scripts/stage-terminal-platform-runtime.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.platform }}
      - name: Stage Windows console wrapper
        if: matrix.os == 'win32'
        run: node ./scripts/stage-opencode-console-wrapper.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.platform }} --require
      - name: Build app
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=8192
        run: pnpm build
      - name: Select exact Host Node for candidate staging
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
      - name: Prepare actual pinned V2 Bun, engine and admitted process custody
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_INPUTS_RECEIPT: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-packaged-inputs.json
        run: node --import tsx scripts/legacy-agent-host/prepare-opencode-v2-native.ts
      - name: Prefill pinned macOS arm64 Host Node archive
        if: matrix.platform == 'darwin-arm64'
        run: node scripts/ci/prefill-legacy-host-macos-node.mts
      - name: Stage V2 Host closure in existing candidate extraResources
        run: node scripts/legacy-agent-host/stage-opencode-v2-packaged.ts
      - name: Typecheck and test packaged Host capture boundaries
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.legacy-agent-host-scripts.json
          node --test scripts/legacy-agent-host/candidate-closure.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/packaged-opencode-v2-inputs.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/stage-node.test.ts
      - name: Verify and stage original Windows scoped broker for packaged Retry
        if: matrix.os == 'win32'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tools/owned-process-broker/tsconfig.json
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original broker compiler failed' }
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tools/owned-process-broker/tsconfig.retained-host.json
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original retained Host compiler failed' }
          node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --maxWorkers=1 --config tools/owned-process-broker/vitest.config.ts
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original broker protocol cases failed' }
          node --check tools/owned-process-broker/nativeWindowsAppGate.mjs
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Packaged Windows driver syntax failed' }
          $build = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("TEST-Windows-UI-build-" + $env:GITHUB_RUN_ID + "-" + $env:RUNNER_ARCH)
          $stage = Join-Path $PWD 'resources\legacy-agent-host\windows-retry-custody'
          if (Test-Path $stage) { throw 'Windows Retry broker destination must be absent' }
          $cmake = (Get-Command cmake.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/build/buildOwnedProcessBroker.ts ${{ matrix.arch }} $build $stage $cmake service-scopes-v1
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original scoped broker stage failed' }
          "WINDOWS_RETRY_BUILD=$build" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Package unsigned test bundle
        env:
          CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: 'false'
        # Only the two macOS commands omit DMG/ZIP in the intermediate draft lane.
        # Native rebuild, staging and every bundle smoke below remain mandatory.
        run: pnpm ${{ matrix.pack }} --publish never --config.mac.identity=null --config.mac.forceCodeSigning=false --config.mac.notarize=false ${{ matrix.os == 'darwin' && needs.packaged-scope.outputs.scope == 'app' && '--dir' || '' }}
      - name: Verify bundle native architecture
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/verifyBundle.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.arch }}
      - name: Smoke packaged SQLite and PTY modules
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokePackagedNative.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" ${{ matrix.os }}
      - name: Smoke packaged Git without external installation
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokeManagedGit.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.arch }}
      - name: Smoke managed Git inside native Windows terminal
        if: matrix.os == 'win32'
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokeManagedTerminalGit.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" ${{ matrix.arch }}
      - name: Smoke packaged MCP handshake
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokePackagedMcp.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" ${{ matrix.os }}
      - name: Verify macOS 13 minimum
        if: matrix.os == 'darwin'
        run: test "$(plutil -extract LSMinimumSystemVersion raw -o - '${{ matrix.bundle }}/Contents/Info.plist')" = '13.0'
      - name: Smoke packaged app
        if: matrix.os != 'linux'
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokePackagedApp.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" ${{ matrix.os }}
      - name: Qualify packaged macOS OpenCode project-path status and model list
        if: matrix.os == 'darwin'
        run: node scripts/e2e/opencode-project-path-packaged.mjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}"
      - name: Smoke packaged app under Xvfb
        if: matrix.os == 'linux'
        run: xvfb-run -a node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokePackagedApp.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" linux
      - name: Qualify actual packaged V2 Host tools, MCP, Stop and cold Resume
        # The runner restores its disposable checkout and the intact legacy payload
        # in finally. No parent shell may keep the Windows checkout as its cwd.
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_PACKAGED_RECEIPT: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-packaged.json
        run: node "${{ github.workspace }}/scripts/legacy-agent-host/run-packaged-opencode-v2.ts" "${{ matrix.bundle }}" "${{ matrix.platform }}"
      - name: Qualify packaged Windows same-Main Retry and original Processes UI Kill with finite peers
        if: matrix.os == 'win32'
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $bundle = (Resolve-Path '${{ matrix.bundle }}').Path
          $apps = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $bundle -File -Filter '*.exe' | Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch 'uninstall' })
          if ($apps.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Expected one original packaged application executable' }
          $app = $apps[0].FullName
          $broker = Join-Path $bundle 'resources\legacy-agent-host\windows-retry-custody\owned-process-broker.exe'

  packaged-full-gate:
    needs: [packaged-scope, packaged-smoke]
    if: always() && !cancelled()
    name: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body) && 'metadata packaged gate' || 'packaged full gate' }}
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
      - name: Require selected packaging verification
        if: needs.packaged-scope.outputs.scope != 'full' || needs.packaged-scope.outputs.run != 'false'
        env:
          PACKAGED_SCOPE: ${{ needs.packaged-scope.outputs.scope }}
          SCOPE_RESULT: ${{ needs.packaged-scope.result }}
          PACKAGED_RESULT: ${{ needs.packaged-smoke.result }}
          PACKAGED_RUN: ${{ needs.packaged-scope.outputs.run }}
        run: node scripts/ci/packaged-ci-cli.mts gate
      - name: Preserve existing code checks after metadata edits
        if: needs.packaged-scope.outputs.scope == 'full' && needs.packaged-scope.outputs.run == 'false'
        run: echo 'Title/body edit only. Existing packaged code checks are unchanged.'
